column5: Same as Heal, but does not trigger healing related effects from abilities
Gain an extra action opportunity to attack the source of the damage. Unless otherwise specified, default to using normal attacks to counterattack
Ignores defense, damage reduction, final damage reduction, and can't be blocked
The more debuffs the enemy has, the higher the probability. When the enemy has 5 types of debuffs, probability is 100%
Base 40% chance plus 5% for each debuff from the source of damage
Blocking an attack reduces Dmg by their Block Amount. Physical Damage is reduced by a further 20%
Absorbs incoming Dmg. Shields reduce incoming Superpower Damage by 10%.
Immune to Damage, Debuffs, and Control Effects.
